primept.settings.ser.tooltip:
Use prepared SER stages for either realtime renderer on supported devices.
Command: /pt ser on|off
primept.settings.rr.tooltip:
Denoise and reconstruct with DLSS RR at the selected quality. Native resolution PT is used when RR is disabled or unavailable.
Command: /pt rr on|off
primept.settings.quality.tooltip:
Applies when RR is enabled and available. Default Performance renders at roughly half width and height (2× upscale), preserving window output resolution.
Command: /pt quality dlaa|quality|balanced|performance|ultra_performance
primept.settings.samples.tooltip:
Plain PT and offline mode trace 1–64 paths per pixel per frame. Realtime ReSTIR uses one initial candidate per frame. RR averages this frame before reconstruction.
Command: /pt spp 1..64
primept.settings.bounces.tooltip:
Allow 1–64 vertices per path, including the primary hit. The last vertex still evaluates direct lighting and emission.
Command: /pt bounces 1..64
primept.settings.sun_ev.tooltip: Scales direct sunlight, scattered sky light and aerial perspective together. The default is 0 EV. Each +1 EV doubles the intensity.
primept.settings.block_emission_ev.toolt: Scales emission from blocks and materials and the light they cast. The default is 0 EV. Each +1 EV doubles the intensity.
primept.settings.latitude.tooltip: Positive is north, negative is south. Latitude controls the height and bearing of the Sun across the day.
primept.settings.solar_longitude.tooltip: Northern spring equinox at 0°, summer solstice at 90°, autumn equinox at 180°, winter solstice at 270°.
primept.settings.update_budget.tooltip: Controls capture, meshing, and publication work per frame. Smooth spreads chunk updates out. Throughput loads chunks faster.
primept.settings.exposure.tooltip:
Adjust brightness after RR and before display mapping. +1 EV doubles brightness. The slider previews 0.25 EV steps and saves on release. Opening settings preserves precise command values.
Command: /pt exposure -16..16
primept.settings.auto_exposure.tooltip: Scales the exposure correction from scene metering. At 0% the automatic correction is off. At 100% the full correction applies. Defaults to 65%. Manual EV remains an additional offset.
primept.settings.drt_saturation.tooltip: Controls saturation compensation during primeDRT gamut mapping. Defaults to 5%.
primept.settings.drt_hue.tooltip: Controls hue compensation during primeDRT gamut mapping. Defaults to 75%.
primept.settings.drt_compression_start.t: Sets where the highlight compression curve leaves its linear segment. Defaults to 40%.
primept.settings.enabled.tooltip:
Enable Prime rendering. Disabling restores vanilla rendering and keeps your realtime renderer selection.
Command: /pt enabled on|off
primept.settings.mode.tooltip:
Offline freezes the current scene, camera and lighting and continuously accumulates independent paths at full output resolution. The game keeps running. Returning to realtime resumes world updates. Offline is session only.
Command: /pt mode realtime|offline
primept.settings.realtime_renderer.toolt:
Choose the realtime integrator. Offline uses independent path accumulation and preserves this selection.
Command: /pt renderer path_trace|restir_pt
primept.settings.restir_cap.tooltip:
Limit temporal reservoir history to 1–100. This preserves each source path's sampling weight.
Command: /pt mcap 1..100
primept.settings.restir_cv.tooltip:
Reduce ReSTIR color noise with temporal and spatial control variates. Enabled by default. Toggling starts fresh color history and preserves path history.
Command: /pt cv on|off
primept.settings.restir_fresh.tooltip:
Choose the fresh estimate independently at this fixed probability to reduce output correlation. 0% shows reuse, 100% shows fresh. Reuse stages still run.
Command: /pt fresh 0..100
primept.settings.diagnostic.tooltip:
Native resolution, no RR or frame accumulation. Plain PT averages the configured SPP within each frame; ReSTIR keeps one initial candidate and internal reuse. Display exposure and quality preferences remain active.
Command: /pt diagnostic on|off
